name: Arrow bounce
summary: Big chunky arrow that pops in and bounces to point at something; for pointing out a detail.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; arrow is about 280 px tall at s = 1

params.name: dir
params.note: direction the arrow points and bounces

params.name: color
params.note: arrow colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
